subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should `read` get a narrow binary-document fallback now, or should this issue wait for broader document extraction/provider-native file work?
rationale: Current source still has the token-waste behavior, but extraction and provider-native file support touch broader product and security boundaries, and the open narrow PR is conflicting.

options.title: Land Narrow Fallback
options.body: Review, repair, or replace the linked guard PR so known PDF/Office reads return a clear fallback message while text and image reads remain unchanged.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Document Work
options.body: Keep this issue as context for the broader extraction/provider-native file design and close or supersede the conflicting narrow PR.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Fallback
recommendation.body: Review, repair, or replace the linked guard PR so known PDF/Office reads return a clear fallback message while text and image reads remain unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The historical read-wrapper commits make this the strongest available routing signal for the product-boundary decision.
